summary.name: incident.io Blog
summary.one_liner: The engineering and product blog of incident.io, an incident management company, covering incident response practices, tooling, and hiring.
use_cases: Subscribing to incident management articles via RSS
summary.what_it_does: The page is the blog index for incident.io, a vendor of incident management software. Its meta description says the posts are written by engineers and leaders and cover incident response best practices, tooling, hiring, and related topics. The visible text shows article titles such as "Register: How to give the agent your tools without giving up control" and "So good, you'll break things on purpose". The page offers an RSS feed for subscribing. No individual article bodies are included in the captured text.
notable: Written by engineers and leaders in the incident management space
Covers incident response best practices, tooling, and hiring
Listed as an incident response resource in dastergon/awesome-sre
caveats: Page text is an index of posts; individual article content was not captured
Blog is published by a commercial vendor (incident.io) and promotes its product
